messages:
Alex Park: Kicking off coordination for a joint marketplace + SI bundle: Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant. Two parallel tracks: marketplace listing (Snow/DBX) and SI/hardware bundle (DGX/Aurora). Need owners.
Maria Gonzalez: Snow requested a mid-April announcement, tentatively 2026-04-15. We should align timelines with pricing and legal.
Tariq Khan: Quick question on Snow marketplace packaging: do we submit a container image or a descriptor + scripts? Also any constraints on telemetry/third-party endpoints?
Samir Patel: Eng input: Marketplace wants container image or a deployable reference with an automated ingest example. I can produce a reference arch doc, container manifest, and a short ingest script sample by EOW (3/26).
Alex Park: Hardware partners want the bundle SKU spelled out for DGX + Aurora edge. We need pricing guidance before legal review.
Maria Gonzalez: Proposed milestone plan: partner review 3/28, legal sign-off 4/06, announcement 4/15. I'll loop in pricing ops.
Ecosystem Bot: Reminder: Marketplace checklist: product schema, logos, lead contact, support email, and compliance attestation due in 7 days.
Tariq Khan: For Qdrant integration we need a sample vector mapping and batch upsert example. Samir, can you add a `POST /vectors/upsert` snippet?
Samir Patel: Yes. Example I'll include: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"vectors":[{"id":"doc1","values":[0.1,0.2],"metadata":{"source":"snow-demo"}}]}'`
Alex Park: SI enablement: propose two enablement sessions week of 4/1 (technical deep-dive + GTM). Also need an SI-facing runbook and escalation matrix.
Maria Gonzalez: Agreed. Messaging note from Snow: use "validated integration" language, avoid exclusivity phrasing. I'll draft comms and invites.
Tariq Khan: Support plan: shared pager and a 72-hour triage runbook post-launch. Define escalation to eng-oncall.
Samir Patel: I'll draft runbook steps, SLO examples (p50/p95 latency, ingestion success rate) and open a PR for code + manifest when ready.
Alex Park: Actions: Samir -> arch + sample by 3/26; Maria -> announcement copy and partner approvals by 3/24; Tariq -> support runbook + paging by 4/10. I'll coordinate pricing/legal. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Updated doc placeholder: https://docs.redwood.com/partnerships/snow-dbx-qdrant-bundle (will populate).
Tariq Khan: If Snow/DBX request SAML/SSO metadata, tag me and I'll provide it.
Alex Park: Thanks team — quick sync Friday to check progress. :rocket:
